scope: Freshly worded research-use tasks frozen outside implementation fixtures before this candidate evaluation. Source-informed by received work and actual prior context; NOT held-out or independent problem discovery. No query-specific ranking/alias changes. The complete-prediction and device cases deliberately have no asserted answer family.
method_budget: Eight returned families per CLI method; five record families plus three distinct source versions per MCP menu. Different budgets are not pooled into an accuracy claim.

tasks.query: I can calibrate a noisy quantum source before any unknown payload arrives. Its hidden memory may move into previously unseen states later. Can ordinary local preparation and readout certify a frozen coherent receiver, with a finite budget that may decline service instead of assuming a supplied output eigenvalue floor?

A field arrives in fixed temporal batches and may already be correlated with my source. I need its commuting quadrature measurement with all actual readout records, while retiring measured modes immediately. What determines the quantum register needed between arrivals, and what does that count leave out?

I already paid to acquire a potential and a source-bearing flux for a killed diffusion. Can I reuse those witnesses to bound survival until every independent exponential deadline, rather than solving once for each rate or inferring the tail from a correct mean?

I have an interacting thermal fermion state with coherence between particle-number sectors. Can a positive charge-sector Gaussian trajectory compiler simulate it just because a sufficient covariance SDP is feasible?

I have short experiment records from a process with hidden quantum memory. I need to optimize a physical recovery map for an entangled future payload while retaining the entire adaptive service record. Which prediction representation controls that task without treating a classical transcript fit as coherent channel reconstruction?

My stationary finite-dimensional source has rare branches and I cannot honestly certify its observable rank or invert a well-conditioned core. Is there a finite short-experiment route to later classical feedback-law prediction that does not normalize on successful rare prefixes?
A small causal bath-memory model predicts a noncommuting driven contact. Does that alone give a passive homodyne eraser for all emitted fields and a one-mode receiver?

Which acquired room-temperature device has actually implemented this source-memory recovery operation, including measured full-record error and end-to-end advantage over a matched ordinary instrument?

I want to reuse a thermal oscillator memory across many sequential contacts and carry the detector record through the comparison. Is a one-contact prediction enough, and what source ports and startup energy information must be known?

My image-pair total-intensity covariance is negative in every recorded block. Can the blur-invariant quadratic receiver still issue a normalized mechanical force or torque by changing the denominator sign?

I can only send logical states into a sealed encoder and measure its outputs. May I deliberately populate unseen error syndromes with the same pre-noise injection used in the three-qubit exploration construction?

post_design.query: A cheap classical sensor can repeatedly read an unchanged label through a stationary channel. Does an exact simulator with finite expected work also give a deterministic cap or preserve a coherent unknown input?

An adaptive force experiment stops at a random time. Does a lower bound using expected stopping under the alternative give a deadline or a null-model runtime guarantee, and is a peak force limit a work budget?

My beam has been switched off but a detector buffer can still release late marks. Can I use that information and no-click likelihood to improve endpoint inference rather than assume an unavoidable blind latency ceiling?
For repeated entangled quantum payloads interleaved with learning, may I evaluate the cumulative oracle comparator on whatever hidden-memory distribution my imperfect controller actually creates?
Can short noisy dwell-time records from an enzyme reaction network certify that there is no additional rare hidden pathway, without a supplied state-dimension bound or repeatable full-process starts?
